text.en: Welcome to Catopia, {name}! I'm so happy you're here to live with me.
text.zh-CN: 欢迎来到 Catopia，{name}！你愿意来和我一起生活，我太开心啦～

text.en: On our little island we grow crops, gather all sorts of things, raise animals, and make friends — we can even sail off to other islands.
text.zh-CN: 在我们这座小岛上，可以种地、采集各种东西、养小动物、交新朋友——还能坐船去别的小岛玩。

text.en: Everything we need is right around our house — a mailbox, a storage chest, and more. We'll get to know it all together.
text.zh-CN: 咱们需要的东西都在家附近——邮箱、储物箱，等等。以后一样一样慢慢认识～

text.en: Oh — Jamin sent us some seeds! I put them in the chest. Let's find a nice open spot and plant something together!
text.zh-CN: 对了——Jamin 给咱们送了些种子！我放在储物箱里了。咱们找块空地，一起种点东西吧！
